hook.name: RobinhoodV4SelectableFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1.5% base fee plus a configurable creator fee (0–10%), collected only in the payment token (not the launch token). Pool creation and liquidity additions are restricted to a factory and position manager; fees are distributed as ERC-6909 claims to a recipient set immutably at pool registration.
